sentences.text:
LABOUR CHANDAULA  WARD NO. 05 POLICE STATION DEVLOND TEHSIL  BEOHARI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ALOK KUMAR GUPTA, ADVOCATE )

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION DEVLOND SHAHDOL (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI C. M. TIWARI, GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 14.1.2023 in connection with Crime No.11/2023 registered at Police Station Devlond, District Shahdol (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 376(2)(d) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a teenager boy aged about 17 years and was in love affair with a girl aged about 14 years and 6 months.
Report was lodged when prosecutrix got pregnant.
It is submitted that applicant has falsely been implicated in the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is minor aged below 16 years.
She does not have sufficient understanding and maturity.
In these circumstances he may not be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant is a young boy of about 17-18 years and is a teenageer.
He is first offender.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
6. Considering the relationship of applicant and prosecutrix, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
